issues.passage: His unequivocal reply was that the outcome might change under several unknowns.
issues.why: An unequivocal reply can clearly and unambiguously state that the outcome is uncertain. Leaving no doubt about uncertainty is still correct use of unequivocal = clear and unambiguous; a student who knows the word would accept this sentence.

fix.correctPassage: The committee issued an unequivocal statement endorsing the revised policy.
wrongPassages: His unequivocal answer was hedged with maybes and left three incompatible readings open.
The instructions were unequivocal: three conflicting steps and no final choice.
She offered an unequivocal shrug that left the panel more uncertain than before.
